items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: they started with a ballad which was unusual for Jimmy Mosher

ctx.x: Yes. I enjoyed the band. You know he respected me and if he respected you he would take a chance on you — if he respected you as a player he’d take a chance on you as a writer. That’s why a lot of the guys in the band were writing charts for the band, because he respected their playing and he would listen to what they had to write. Well I was on the Glenn Miller band for three years, almost three years with Buddy DeFranco. And I learned a lot from him as well. So all the time I was on the Glenn Miller band I was…

it to your apartment, because you know it’s not worth anything, it’s just like a used car, they’ll give you so much for the trade in. Anyway, long story short, I was on unemployment and I heard that Buddy had signed, Pat told me that Buddy had signed with RCA Victor. And so I was making fifty bucks a week on unemployment and then doing odd jobs. A bus trip to Philadelphia was 25 bucks. So I bought a bus ticket to Philadelphia with this “Piece of the Road” suite that I wrote. And everybody was there at the club,…
Man, I bet your made sure that the parts were all correct. I mean did you do the copying by yourself at that time?
